calibration_block.construction: R98 cf4_p1: T=-(ln10/5) A W; Sigma = SNIa-gauge rank-5 overlap cov5 + 0.087^2 common + 0.5^2 DirectCal

definitions.bulk_response: 1+z_obs=(1+z)(1+B.n/c); dy/dB = (1+z)(1/z + dlnf/dz) n / c, f from ReadMe Note 6 (Omega_m 0.27, Omega_L 0.73)
definitions.coefficients: R98 36-vector: 4 windows x [monopole, nx, ny, nz (ICRS), 5 STF] of y = ln(fV3k/74.6) - (ln10/5)(DMzp-25)
definitions.expansion_dipole_response: H(n)=Hbar(1+h.n) at fixed distance; dy/dh = (1 + z dlnf/dz) n
definitions.frame: CF4 release CMB frame (V3k); conversion to the Planck 2018 frame is applied in frame_lie_flux.py with registry keys
definitions.holdout: pre-fixed: train on all 18 inner-window coefficients (z=0.025, 0.040), predict the 6 outer-window dipole coefficients (z=0.060, 0.080)
definitions.literature_axes: R105 CF4_H05_AXES.json unit_icrs (Boubel 2025 fig4 (142,52); Stiskalek 2026 sec4.1 (127,10)); as_mag = (h.axis)/(ln10/5)
definitions.nuisance: free monopole and 5 STF coefficients in every window (a common zero point moves monopoles only)
definitions.window_weights_held_fixed: weights use the observed z; second-order change of weights under B or h is neglected

label: CONDITIONAL: working covariance without coherent large-scale peculiar-velocity covariance; CF4 all-method groups, not the W1 Tully-Fisher subset of the literature (not the same estimand)
not_included: coherent large-scale peculiar-velocity covariance of the 36-vector (R98 computed it in-run; matrices not saved)
